````html
@section Scripts {
    <script>
        (function () {
            var searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
            var filterEstado = document.getElementById('filterEstado');
            var filterCondicion = document.getElementById('filterCondicion');
            var table = document.getElementById('proveedoresTable');
            if (table) {
                var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');

                function filterRows() {
                    var search = (searchInput?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    var estado = filterEstado?.value || '';
                    var condicion = filterCondicion?.value || '';

                    rows.forEach(function (row) {
                        var nombre = row.dataset.nombre || '';
                        var rtn = row.dataset.rtn || '';
                        var email = row.dataset.email || '';
                        var codigo = row.dataset.codigo || '';
                        var rowEstado = row.dataset.estado || '';
                        var rowCondicion = row.dataset.condicion || '';

                        var matchSearch = !search || nombre.includes(search) || rtn.includes(search) || email.includes(search) || codigo.includes(search);
                        var matchEstado = !estado || rowEstado === estado;
                        var matchCondicion = !condicion || rowCondicion === condicion;

                        row.style.display = (matchSearch && matchEstado && matchCondicion) ? '' : 'none';
                    });
                }

                searchInput?.addEventListener('input', filterRows);
                filterEstado?.addEventListener('change', filterRows);
                filterCondicion?.addEventListener('change', filterRows);
            }
        })();

        function mostrarOpcionesExport() {
            document.getElementById('modalExport').style.display = 'flex';
            actualizarLinkExport();
        }
        function cerrarModalExport() {
            document.getElementById('modalExport').style.display = 'none';
        }
        function actualizarLinkExport() {
            var formato = document.getElementById('exportFormato').value;
            var soloActivos = document.getElementById('exportSoloActivos').checked;
            document.getElementById('btnDescargarExport').href =
                '/Proveedores/Export?formato=' + formato + '&soloActivos=' + soloActivos;
        }
        document.getElementById('exportFormato')?.addEventListener('change', actualizarLinkExport);
        document.getElementById('exportSoloActivos')?.addEventListener('change', actualizarLinkExport);
    </script>
}
````

===== FILE: Pages/Proveedores/Index.cshtml.cs =====

````csharp
using Kirkenta.Data;
using Kirkenta.Helpers;
using Kirkenta.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;

namespace Kirkenta.Pages.Proveedores
{
    public class IndexModel : PageModel
    {
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context;

        public IndexModel(ApplicationDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        public List<Proveedor> Proveedores { get; set; } = new();
        public List<Moneda> Monedas { get; set; } = new();
        public bool PuedeExportar { get; set; }
        public bool PuedeImportar { get; set; }

        public void OnGet()
        {
            var currentUser = _context.Usuarios.FirstOrDefault(u => u.Username == User.Identity!.Name);
            var currentRol = currentUser?.Rol ?? "Pendiente";

            if (currentRol != "Admin" &&
                !PermisoHelper.TienePermiso(_context, currentRol, "Compras", "Proveedores", "ver"))
            {
                TempData["Error"] = "No tienes permiso";
                return;
            }

            PuedeExportar = currentRol == "Admin" || PermisoHelper.TienePermiso(_context, currentRol, "Compras", "ProveedoresExport", "ver");
            PuedeImportar = currentRol == "Admin" || PermisoHelper.TienePermiso(_context, currentRol, "Compras", "ProveedoresImport", "crear");

            Proveedores = _context.Proveedores.OrderBy(p => p.Nombre).ToList();
            Monedas = _context.Monedas.Where(m => m.Activa).ToList();
        }
    }
}
````

````html
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>@ViewData["Title"] - Kirkenta POS</title>
    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="~/favicon.png?v=@DateTime.Now.Ticks" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="~/favicon.png" />
    <link rel="shortcut icon" type="image/png" href="~/favicon.png" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="~/lib/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/theme.css?v=@DateTime.Now.Ticks" />
</head>
<body class="pos-body">
    @Html.AntiForgeryToken()
    <div class="pos-container">
        <header class="pos-header">
            <div class="pos-header-left">
                <a asp-page="/Index" class="pos-back-btn" title="Volver al sistema">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/>
                        <polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"/>
                    </svg>
                </a>
                <div class="pos-brand">
                    <img src="~/images/logo.png" alt="Kirkenta" />
                    <div>
                        <h1>Punto de Venta</h1>
                        <p>@DateTime.Now.ToString("dddd, dd MMMM yyyy HH:mm")</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="pos-header-right">
                <div class="pos-user">
                    <span class="pos-user-name">@User.Identity?.Name</span>
                    <span class="pos-user-role">@User.FindFirst(System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.Role)?.Value</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </header>

        @RenderBody()
    </div>

    <script src="~/lib/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js"></script>
    <script src="~/lib/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script src="~/js/site.js" asp-append-version="true"></script>

    @await RenderSectionAsync("Scripts", required: false)
</body>
</html>
````

````html
@page "{id:int}"
@model Kirkenta.Pages.Ventas.DetailsModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = $"Venta {Model.Venta.Numero}";
}

<div class="module-header">
    <div class="module-header-left">
        <a asp-page="/Ventas/Index" class="back-link">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/>
                <polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"/>
            </svg>
            Volver a ventas
        </a>
        <h2>Venta @Model.Venta.Numero</h2>
        <p>@Model.Venta.Fecha.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm")</p>
    </div>
    <div class="module-header-right">
        @if (Model.Venta.Estado != "Anulada")
        {
            <a asp-page="/Facturas/CreateFromVenta" asp-route-ventaId="@Model.Venta.Id" class="btn-primary">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="btn-icon">
                    <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                    <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                </svg>
                Generar factura
            </a>
        }
    </div>
</div>

<div class="module-card" style="padding: 28px;">
    <div class="cotizacion-header">
        <div class="cotizacion-info">
            <h3>Cliente</h3>
            @if (Model.Cliente != null)
            {
                <p><strong>@Model.Cliente.Nombre</strong></p>
                @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Model.Cliente.RTN))
                {
                    <p>RTN: @Model.Cliente.RTN</p>
                }
            }
            else
            {
                <p>Consumidor final</p>
            }
        </div>
        <div class="cotizacion-estado">
            <span class="badge @(Model.Venta.Estado == "Completada" ? "badge-success" : "badge-danger")" style="font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 14px;">
                @Model.Venta.Estado
            </span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="table-wrapper" style="margin-top: 24px;">
        <table class="erp-table">
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>Producto</th>
                    <th style="text-align: right;">Cantidad</th>
                    <th style="text-align: right;">Precio</th>
                    <th style="text-align: right;">Total</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                @foreach (var item in Model.Items)
                {
                    var prod = Model.Productos.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Id == item.ProductoId);
                    <tr>
                        <td>@(prod?.Nombre ?? "—")</td>
                        <td style="text-align: right;">@item.Cantidad</td>
                        <td style="text-align: right;">L. @item.PrecioUnitario.ToString("N2")</td>
                        <td style="text-align: right;"><strong>L. @item.Total.ToString("N2")</strong></td>
                    </tr>
                }
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <div class="totales-panel" style="margin-top: 24px;">
        <div class="totales-row">
            <span>Subtotal:</span>
            <strong>L. @Model.Venta.Subtotal.ToString("N2")</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="totales-row">
            <span>Descuento:</span>
            <strong>L. @Model.Venta.Descuento.ToString("N2")</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="totales-row">
            <span>Impuestos:</span>
            <strong>L. @Model.Venta.Impuestos.ToString("N2")</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="totales-row totales-row-final">
            <span>TOTAL:</span>
            <strong>L. @Model.Venta.Total.ToString("N2")</strong>
        </div>
    </div>

    @if (Model.Pagos.Count > 0)
    {
        <div style="margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);">
            <h4 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px;">Pagos registrados</h4>
            <div class="table-wrapper">
                <table class="erp-table">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>Fecha</th>
                            <th>Método</th>
                            <th>Referencia</th>
                            <th style="text-align: right;">Monto</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        @foreach (var p in Model.Pagos)
                        {
                            var metodo = Model.MetodosPago.FirstOrDefault(m => m.Id == p.MetodoPagoId);
                            <tr>
                                <td>@p.Fecha.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm")</td>
                                <td>@(metodo?.Nombre ?? "—")</td>
                                <td>@(p.Referencia ?? "—")</td>
                                <td style="text-align: right;"><strong>L. @p.Monto.ToString("N2")</strong></td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
    }
</div>
````

===== FILE: Pages/Ventas/Details.cshtml.cs =====

````csharp
using Kirkenta.Data;
using Kirkenta.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;

namespace Kirkenta.Pages.Ventas
{
    public class DetailsModel : PageModel
    {
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context;

        public DetailsModel(ApplicationDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        public Venta Venta { get; set; } = new();
        public Cliente? Cliente { get; set; }
        public List<DetalleVenta> Items { get; set; } = new();
        public List<Producto> Productos { get; set; } = new();
        public List<Pago> Pagos { get; set; } = new();
        public List<MetodoPago> MetodosPago { get; set; } = new();

        public IActionResult OnGet(int id)
        {
            var venta = _context.Ventas.FirstOrDefault(v => v.Id == id);
            if (venta == null)
            {
                TempData["Error"] = "Venta no encontrada";
                return RedirectToPage("/Ventas/Index");
            }

            Venta = venta;
            Cliente = venta.ClienteId.HasValue
                ? _context.Clientes.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == venta.ClienteId.Value)
                : null;
            Items = _context.DetalleVentas.Where(d => d.VentaId == id).ToList();
            Productos = _context.Productos.ToList();
            Pagos = _context.Pagos.Where(p => p.VentaId == id).ToList();
            MetodosPago = _context.MetodosPago.ToList();

            return Page();
        }
    }
}
````

===== FILE: Pages/Ventas/Index.cshtml =====

````html
@page
@model Kirkenta.Pages.Ventas.IndexModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Ventas";
}

<div class="module-header">
    <div class="module-header-left">
        <h2>Ventas</h2>
        <p>Historial de todas las ventas registradas</p>
    </div>
    <div class="module-header-right">
        <a asp-page="/POS/Index" class="btn-primary">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="btn-icon">
                <circle cx="9" cy="21" r="1"/>
                <circle cx="20" cy="21" r="1"/>
                <path d="M1 1h4l2.68 13.39a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.61h9.72a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.61L23 6H6"/>
            </svg>
            Nuevo POS
        </a>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="module-card">
    <div class="module-toolbar">
        <div class="search-box">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
                <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/>
            </svg>
            <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="Buscar por número o cliente..." />
        </div>
        <div class="filter-group">
            <input type="date" id="filterFechaDesde" class="filter-select" />
            <input type="date" id="filterFechaHasta" class="filter-select" />
        </div>
    </div>

    @if (TempData["Success"] != null)
    {
        <div class="module-alert module-alert-success">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
                <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
            </svg>
            @TempData["Success"]
        </div>
    }

    @if (Model.Ventas.Count == 0)
    {
        <div class="empty-state">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <circle cx="9" cy="21" r="1"/>
                <circle cx="20" cy="21" r="1"/>
                <path d="M1 1h4l2.68 13.39a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.61h9.72a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.61L23 6H6"/>
            </svg>
            <h3>No hay ventas registradas</h3>
            <p>Usa el POS para empezar a vender</p>
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        <div class="table-wrapper">
            <table class="erp-table" id="ventasTable">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>Número</th>
                        <th>Cliente</th>
                        <th>Fecha</th>
                        <th>Total</th>
                        <th>Estado</th>
                        <th style="width: 140px; text-align: right;">Acciones</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    @foreach (var v in Model.Ventas)
                    {
                        var cliente = Model.Clientes.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == v.ClienteId);
                        <tr data-numero="@v.Numero.ToLower()"
                            data-cliente="@(cliente?.Nombre.ToLower() ?? "")"
                            data-fecha="@v.Fecha.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")">
                            <td><strong>@v.Numero</strong></td>
                            <td>@(cliente?.Nombre ?? "Consumidor final")</td>
                            <td>@v.Fecha.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm")</td>
                            <td><strong>L. @v.Total.ToString("N2")</strong></td>
                            <td>
                                @if (v.Estado == "Completada")
                                {
                                    <span class="badge badge-success">Completada</span>
                                }
                                else if (v.Estado == "Anulada")
                                {
                                    <span class="badge badge-danger">Anulada</span>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <span class="badge badge-warning">@v.Estado</span>
                                }
                            </td>
                            <td>
                                <div class="table-actions">
                                    <a asp-page="/Ventas/Details" asp-route-id="@v.Id" class="btn-icon-action" title="Ver detalle">
                                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                                            <path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/>
                                            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
                                        </svg>
                                    </a>
                                    <a asp-page="/Facturas/CreateFromVenta" asp-route-ventaId="@v.Id" class="btn-icon-action" title="Facturar">
                                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                                            <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                                            <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                                        </svg>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        (function () {
            var searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
            var desde = document.getElementById('filterFechaDesde');
            var hasta = document.getElementById('filterFechaHasta');
            var table = document.getElementById('ventasTable');
            if (!table) return;
            var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');

            function filterRows() {
                var search = (searchInput?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                var fDesde = desde?.value || '';
                var fHasta = hasta?.value || '';

                rows.forEach(function (row) {
                    var numero = row.dataset.numero || '';
                    var cliente = row.dataset.cliente || '';
                    var fecha = row.dataset.fecha || '';

                    var matchSearch = !search || numero.includes(search) || cliente.includes(search);
                    var matchDesde = !fDesde || fecha >= fDesde;
                    var matchHasta = !fHasta || fecha <= fHasta;

                    row.style.display = (matchSearch && matchDesde && matchHasta) ? '' : 'none';
                });
            }

            searchInput?.addEventListener('input', filterRows);
            desde?.addEventListener('change', filterRows);
            hasta?.addEventListener('change', filterRows);
        })();
    </script>
}
````

````csharp
using Kirkenta.Data;
using Kirkenta.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;

namespace Kirkenta.Pages.Ventas
{
    public class IndexModel : PageModel
    {
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context;

        public IndexModel(ApplicationDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        public List<Venta> Ventas { get; set; } = new();
        public List<Cliente> Clientes { get; set; } = new();

        public void OnGet()
        {
            Ventas = _context.Ventas.OrderByDescending(v => v.Fecha).ToList();
            Clientes = _context.Clientes.ToList();
        }
    }
}
````
